published_statement: G&O 0705.3193v2 p.2: 'Condition 1 (self-consistent achronal ANEC) There is no self-consistent solution in semiclassical gravity in which ANEC is violated on a complete, achronal null geodesic. We conjecture that all semiclassical systems obey self-consistent achronal ANEC.' p.3: 'self-consistent achronal ANEC can be proved along the lines of Ref. [3] ... but such a proof will have to await future work.' Abstract: the condition 'is free of known violations'. STATUS LATER, READ: Kontou-Sanders 2020 (2003.01815v2 l.4559): 'The slightly stronger conjecture that the AANEC holds for any self-consistent solution in semiclassical gravity has been advanced by Graham and Olum'; Freivogel-Kontou-Krommydas DSNEC (2111.05772 p.5): 'There are no known counterexamples to self-consistent achronal ANEC in the semi-classical regime'; Kontou 2024 (2405.05963 p.2): 'The ANEC over achronal null geodesics that satisfies the (semiclassical) Einstein equation is free of counterexamples in semiclassical gravity'; Iizuka et al. 2025 (2509.01286 p.64): 'so far, all holographic proofs of ANEC are performed on a fixed background. It remains an open question whether the self-consistent ANEC can be shown by using the holographic semiclassical Einstein equations'; Dorau-Much 2026 (2509.10137 p.2): 'no violations of this condition are currently known'; Fliss 2026 (2605.18964 p.45): 'it has been shown that the generalized second law implies the achronal ANEC [Wall] ... The status of the generalized second law as a scientific law is still uncertain however.'
published_hypotheses: H1 SELF-CONSISTENCY: the spacetime solves Einstein's equation with the FULL stress tensor -- classical matter plus the induced quantum <T_ab> on that curvature (G&O p.2); not a test field on a fixed background.

H2 SEMICLASSICAL REGIME: 'Condition 1 should be expected to hold only in cases where the curvature is well below the Planck scale' (G&O p.3); this is what excludes the Barcelo-Visser classical violations (Planck-scale field values) and the scale-anomaly violation (Sec. III).
H3 COMPLETE geodesic: the ANEC integral is over a complete null geodesic (G&O p.2).
H4 ACHRONAL geodesic: no two points joined by a timelike path (G&O p.2); excludes the compactified-Minkowski and Schwarzschild/Boulware violations (Sec. II).
No spacetime dimension is stated in Condition 1 (G&O p.2); the 1+1 massless-scalar case is credited as proved by Wald-Yurtsever [5].

For the consequences (Lemma 1, topological censorship, no CTC construction): the null generic condition, and per theorem asymptotic flatness / global hyperbolicity / simple connectivity / partial asymptotic predictability (G&O Sec. IV; Kontou 2024 Thm 2 restating G&O's Tipler version).
The STATUS claim itself ('open') has no hypotheses in the source; it is a literature-status statement, read here in the 2020-2026 reviews listed.

The same drop recurs at the sibling sites achronal.py:124-128, obstruct.py:178/190, index3.py:415/754, smearing.py:104-107, WARP-DRIVE.md:47 and 573, paper/CLAIMS.md:202-204.

DATING (a discrepancy of framing, not an error): 'nineteen years' (anecscope.py:36, 171; canonical hypothesis 'dated from Graham & Olum 2007') counts from G&O's naming of Condition 1. The same question is older on G&O's own account: the self-consistency requirement 'appears to have been introduced by Penrose, Sorkin and Woolgar [6]' (1993) and 'Flanagan and Wald [7] ... stated ANEC in the achronal form' in self-consistent perturbation theory (1996) (G&O p.2-4). So 19 yr is a LOWER bound on how long the question has stood (30.6 yr from FW 1996; rederive A). Neither direction favours M.

WEAKENED at sibling sites (not anecscope.py): 'no proof and no counterexample' (achronal.py:127-128, 467-468; paper/CLAIMS.md:204; WARP-DRIVE.md:573) flattens the conditional proof of Wall 0910.5751 (achronal ANEC on null lines from the GSL, for fields minimally coupled to semiclassical gravity, small gravitational perturbation, CPT, a renormalisation scheme; 'similar in scope to the self-consistent achronal ANEC' -- Wall p.3), whose GSL premise is proven for free / super-renormalisable fields on small perturbations of stationary causal horizons (restated GJW 1608.05687 p.2; Fliss 2605.18964 p.45). 'Open in general' survives; 'no proof' of any kind does not. anecscope.py itself says only 'open' (anecscope.py:34-36, 171) and is not affected.

'no counterexample' (same sibling sites) omits G&O's own undecided case: Flanagan-Wald's first-order ANEC violations for MIXED states in self-consistent perturbation theory about Minkowski, where 'we cannot be sure whether the geodesics are chronal or not' (G&O p.4). An undecided candidate, not a counterexample; READ reviews through 2026 still report no known counterexample.

ADDED at sibling sites: 'in 4D' / 'in four dimensions' (achronal.py:124-125, 467; obstruct.py:190; index3.py:415, 754; smearing.py:106; WARP-DRIVE.md:47, 573). Condition 1 carries no dimension (G&O p.2). The addition is a correct narrowing (the 1+1 massless-scalar case is proved, Wald-Yurtsever, credited by G&O p.2 and Kontou-Sanders l.4575-4578), not a drift against the source.

MISATTRIBUTION at a sibling site: 'Graham & Olum proved it in flat spacetime in 2007' (achronal.py:126; paper/CLAIMS.md:203). G&O prove no ANEC; they credit Wald-Yurtsever [5] with proving Condition 1 for a massless scalar in 1+1 (G&O p.2), and the flat-space proofs are Klinkhammer 1991 / Wald-Yurtsever 1991 (restated Kontou-Sanders l.4574-4579) and Faulkner et al. / Hartman et al. 2016. (Also found independently by the sibling audit 0705.3193.json.) A discrepancy, recorded not repaired.

rederivation.outcome: ALL OK (exit 0). (A) floor(elapsed years) = 19 for every G&O date bound (May 2007 v1, 27 Aug 2007 v2) against the owner commit and today; the question itself is 30.6 yr old from FW 1996. (B) G&O footnote 1 re-derived from the Schwarzschild metric (sympy Christoffels -> Riemann -> static orthonormal frame, k = (1, cos a, sin a, 0)): screen tidal matrix diag(+3M sin^2 a / r^3, -3M sin^2 a / r^3), traceless; k^a k^b k_[t R_r]ab[t k_r] = -(3M / 4 r^3) sin^4 a with unit-weight antisymmetrisation, against G&O's printed -(3M/r^3) sin a. The zero set agrees (radial rays only, every component vanishes there), which is all G&O's argument uses (non-radial complete geodesics generic => conjugate => chronal, so the Boulware violation misses Condition 1). The power of sin a and the factor differ: a DISCREPANCY in the printed footnote (normalisation conventions account for the 1/4, not for sin a vs sin^4 a), recorded, NOT an error in the conclusion. (C) z3: Lemma 1 skeleton (Condition 1 + self-consistent + Borde 'ANEC + generic => conjugate pair' + Hawking-Ellis 'conjugate pair => chronal') makes 'generic and achronal complete geodesic' UNSAT; vacuity guard SAT; dropping the generic condition, or self-consistency, makes the achronal/violating case SAT. The open conjecture itself is not a finite claim and is NOT checked.

later_literature.what: Proves achronal ANEC on null lines from the GSL for fields minimally coupled to semiclassical gravity (CPT, renormalisation scheme, small perturbation) -- 'similar in scope to the self-consistent achronal ANEC ... weaker insofar as it is restricted to ... small [perturbation], stronger insofar as it only requires ... a null line on the background' (p.3). Also: G&O-type theorems 'fail once the linearized graviton field is quantized, because then the renormalized shear squared term in the Raychaudhuri equation can be negative' (abstract) -- a later-found incompleteness of the SUFFICIENCY theorems, not of the status.

State-dependent, arbitrarily large achronal ANEC violation for a conformally coupled scalar on a FIXED conformally flat background; 'It is possible that self-consistency may be enough to enforce the energy conditions in the general case' (p.10). Confirms that only the self-consistent version is still open.

Pre-dates G&O: self-consistent perturbation theory about flat space; pure states first order ANEC integral vanishes; mixed states can be negative; transverse Planck-scale-smeared ANEC strictly positive. Makes the question >= 30 years old; its mixed-state first-order violations are G&O's undecided case.
Calls self-consistent AANEC a conjecture advanced by Graham-Olum; known AANEC violations involve Planck-length distances.

Self-consistent achronal ANEC 'free of counterexamples in semiclassical gravity'; restates G&O Tipler-type no-CTC theorem with its four hypotheses; long wormholes escape (no complete achronal null geodesic).

later_literature.ref: Iizuka, Ishibashi, Maeda, Nakayama & Nishioka, arXiv:2509.01286 (v2 Nov 2025)
later_literature.what: All holographic ANEC proofs are on fixed backgrounds; whether self-consistent ANEC follows from holographic semiclassical Einstein equations 'remains an open question' (p.64). DISCREPANCY recorded, not repaired: p.38 says self-consistent ANEC 'has been shown to hold for pure and mixed states under certain conditions on the curvature scale [77 = Flanagan-Wald]', whereas FW's own abstract says the mixed-state first-order ANEC integral CAN be negative and positivity holds only after transverse Planck-scale smearing.
'no violations of this condition are currently known' (p.2).

GSL implies achronal ANEC (Wall), but 'the status of the generalized second law ... is still uncertain'; Wall's GSL proof assumptions verified for free and super-renormalisable QFTs, an assumption more generally (p.45).

lacked_data: G&O 2007 lacked no experimental datum -- the conjecture is about semiclassical QFT and its evidence is computed <T_kk>. What came later, READ: (a) Urban-Olum 2010's fixed-background violation -- CONFIRMS G&O's choice to demand self-consistency rather than overturning it; (b) Wall 2010's GSL derivation and the GSL proof for free/super-renormalisable fields -- partial, conditional support, not a general proof; (c) holographic ANEC proofs, all on fixed backgrounds (Iizuka et al. 2025); (d) Wall 2010's observation that the sufficiency theorems fail once the linearised graviton is quantised (renormalised shear^2 can be negative) -- a genuine later-found INCOMPLETENESS, but of the consequences G&O draw, not of Condition 1's status, and it cuts toward weakening the no-CTC/no-wormhole theorems (M's direction) only at the level of quantised-graviton shear, which no source read quantifies for a macroscopic geometry, so nothing here may be quoted as a door. Evidence either way: no READ source (through Fliss 2026) reports a counterexample or a general proof. M's hypothesis is therefore NOT borne out for this result: the status 'open' is exactly what later data leave standing. The defects found are in the tree's description (a dropped semiclassical qualifier; a 19-year count that is a lower bound) and in a printed footnote of G&O (sin a vs computed sin^4 a, same zero set) -- discrepancies, not refutations.
grade_evidence: The core status claim STANDS: every review READ from 2020 to 2026 (Kontou-Sanders; DSNEC 2111.05772; Kontou 2024; Iizuka et al. 2025; Dorau-Much 2026; Fliss 2026) treats self-consistent achronal ANEC as unproven in general and free of known counterexamples, and 'nineteen years' is arithmetically right from G&O's 2007 naming (rederive A, floor 19 under every date bound). Graded NARROWED, not STANDS, on one dropped hypothesis: G&O restrict Condition 1 to the semiclassical regime, 'curvature well below the Planck scale' (p.3), and anecscope.py:34-36/170-171 (and every sibling site) states the open conjecture without it -- so the tree shows the conjecture as binding on a larger class than its authors claim, an overstatement against M. Recorded alongside, and not grade-bearing for anecscope.py: the 19 years is a lower bound on the question's age (FW 1996: 30.6 yr); sibling sites flatten Wall 2010's conditional proof into 'no proof', omit G&O's undecided FW mixed-state case from 'no counterexample', and misattribute a flat-space proof to G&O (achronal.py:126, CLAIMS.md:203). Nothing that rests on it moves: REFUTES_ACHRONAL_ANEC = False (anecscope.py:263), NOT_RUN entry 4 (anecscope.py:271) and index3's OUTSIDE-NOT-REFUTED all need only 'open', which stands; a scope finding is unaffected by the conjecture's truth either way. No datum moved.
what_would_change_the_grade: To STANDS: the tree's description carrying G&O's semiclassical (sub-Planck curvature) qualifier. To WRONG (for the status claim): a published general proof of self-consistent achronal ANEC in 4D, or an exhibited self-consistent semiclassical solution violating ANEC on a complete achronal null geodesic -- e.g. FW's first-order mixed-state violations shown to lie on achronal geodesics. To OPEN: nothing here; but a discover_papers pass after the alphaXiv quota resets could surface 2025-2026 work the cached texts do not cover. Reading G&O v1 / the PRD version would settle whether the footnote's 'sin a' is a misprint or a convention.
